title: Moldova Issues Warning About New Cyberattacks Following a Data Breach
content_md: UA News reports: In Moldova, the personal data of approximately 750,000 people may have been stolen following a cyberattack on government digital services. Prime Minister Vasile Tofan stated that such attacks may become increasingly frequent, so the country needs to strengthen its cybersecurity and invest more in the security of government systems.
